title: 真实Zabbix动态容量汇总：剔除陈旧last值，以批准成员数阻止不完整总量发布

body:
## 操作任务
实现expressions(group,key,seconds)：group匹配[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,40}、key匹配[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,40}，seconds为1..3600非bool整数；返回total与members两个Zabbix7.0 calculated item表达式，分别sum(last_foreach(/*/key?[group="group"],Ns))和count(相同foreach)。实现publication(expected,observed,total)：expected为正整数、observed为非负整数，均非bool；total为有限非负int/float且非bool。仅observed==expected允许发布，返回{publish,expected,observed,total}，不完整时total=None。非法输入ValueError。expected来自批准资产清单，不得用过滤后集合自当完整性分母。验收实际官方API、history poller/calculated engine与trapper：陈旧600秒值不进入300秒窗口，新增主机自动加入，退组、禁用、改key导致集合变化，恢复后保持原item ID并重新完整发布。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32动态主机组last_foreach聚合与受控样本时间；总量和覆盖计数分别取实际calculated item历史。批准成员数为外部受控清单样本，未自动发现资产，未验证物理容量或生产看板。只验证启用且支持的trapper项；不把过滤后缺失成员当成不存在。无部署、不构建镜像。

import copy,json,os,pathlib,socket,struct,sys,time
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from private_api import PrivateAPI
assert os.geteuid()==1000 and sys.platform=='linux'
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateAPI() as api:
 api.login()
 group=api.call('hostgroup.create',dict(name='Capacity'))['groupids'][0]
 other=api.call('hostgroup.create',dict(name='OtherCapacity'))['groupids'][0]
 hosts={};items={}
 def add(name):
  hosts[name]=api.call('host.create',dict(host='capacity-'+name,groups=[dict(groupid=group)]))['hostids'][0]
  items[name]=api.call('item.create',dict(hostid=hosts[name],name='Approved capacity',key_='capacity.total',type=2,value_type=3,history='1d',trends='0'))['itemids'][0]
 for name in ('a','b','c'):add(name)
 summary=api.call('host.create',dict(host='capacity-summary',groups=[dict(groupid=other)]))['hostids'][0]
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:real_calculated_foreach_freshness_membership_external_inventory_gate',flush=True)
 plans=task.expressions('Capacity','capacity.total',300)
 assert set(plans)=={'total','members'}
 calculated={}
 for name,formula in plans.items():
  calculated[name]=api.call('item.create',dict(hostid=summary,name='Rollup '+name,key_='rollup.'+name,type=15,value_type=0,params=formula,delay='1s',history='1d',trends='0'))['itemids'][0]
 api.backend.poller_overrides['StartHistoryPollers']=1
 api.backend.start()
 def send(name,value,old=False):
  stamp=time.time_ns()-(600_000_000_000 if old else 0)
  payload=json.dumps(dict(request='sender data',data=[dict(host='capacity-'+name,key='capacity.total',value=str(value),clock=stamp//1000000000,ns=stamp%1000000000)],clock=int(time.time()))).encode()
  with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',api.backend.port),timeout=3) as connection:
   connection.sendall(b'ZBXD\x01'+struct.pack('<Q',len(payload))+payload)
   def read(n):
    raw=b''
    while len(raw)<n:
     part=connection.recv(n-len(raw));assert part;raw+=part
    return raw
   assert read(5)==b'ZBXD\x01';reply=json.loads(read(struct.unpack('<Q',read(8))[0]))
   assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0' in reply['info'],reply
  api.backend.wait(lambda:any(int(row[0])==value for row in api.db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+items[name])),'actual capacity history')
 def last(name):
  rows=api.db.execute('select value from history where itemid='+calculated[name]+' order by clock desc,ns desc limit 1')
  return float(rows[0][0]) if rows else None
 def rollup(total,count,expected,publish):
  api.backend.wait(lambda:last('total')==total and last('members')==count,'actual calculated capacity total/count '+str((total,count)),seconds=15)
  result=task.publication(expected,count,last('total'))
  assert result==dict(publish=publish,expected=expected,observed=count,total=total if publish else None),'incomplete inventory published as full group'
 send('a',100);send('b',200);send('c',300,old=True)
 rollup(300,2,3,False)
 print('NATIVE_STALE_CAPACITY_EXCLUDED_PARTIAL_MEMBER_COUNT_NOT_PUBLISHED',flush=True)
 add('d');api.backend.reload();send('d',400)
 rollup(700,3,4,False)
 send('c',300);rollup(1000,4,4,True)
 api.call('host.update',dict(hostid=hosts['b'],groups=[dict(groupid=other)]));api.backend.reload()
 rollup(800,3,3,True)
 api.call('item.update',dict(itemid=items['a'],status=1));api.backend.reload()
 rollup(700,2,3,False)
 api.call('item.update',dict(itemid=items['c'],key_='capacity.renamed'));api.backend.reload()
 rollup(400,1,3,False)
 api.call('item.update',dict(itemid=items['a'],status=0));api.backend.reload()
 rollup(500,2,3,False)
 api.call('item.update',dict(itemid=items['c'],key_='capacity.total'));api.backend.reload()
 rollup(800,3,3,True)
 assert set(items)=={'a','b','c','d'} and all(api.call('item.get',dict(itemids=[identity],output=['itemid']))==[dict(itemid=identity)] for identity in items.values())
 for args in [('Capacity','capacity.total',True),('Bad"group','capacity.total',300),('Capacity','capacity.total',0)]:
  try:task.expressions(*args)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unsafe filter/window accepted')
 for args in [(True,1,100),(3,3,float('nan')),(3,3,-1)]:
  try:task.publication(*args)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid inventory or capacity accepted')
 print('NATIVE_DYNAMIC_JOIN_LEAVE_DISABLED_RENAMED_RESTORED_WITH_EXTERNAL_APPROVED_MEMBER_DENOMINATOR',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
